title: Pantex ground surveillance radar tracks on aerial imagery
description: Aerial satellite image of the Pantex plant area overlaid with a red track line and yellow markers labelled as track points (TP-1 to TP-5) with timestamps around 07:09 to 07:13. Headed "Ground Surveillance Radar Tracks" on page 4 of 6 of the "Pantex Unidentified Object Incident Report". The facility's fenced building complex is visible at upper right and a pond at centre right.
